articles.title: IN PHOTOS: Mumbai-Delhi trains cancelled, rescheduled ahead of CJP protest - Mid-Day
articles.full_text:
IN PHOTOS: Mumbai-Delhi trains cancelled, rescheduled ahead of CJP protest
Several long-distance trains connecting Mumbai with New Delhi were cancelled or rescheduled by Central Railway and Western Railway on Friday, a day before the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) is scheduled to hold a protest in the national capital against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Pics/Ashish Raje
